about.title: About Archiver
about.intro: Archiver is a personal memory of the web: it keeps a copy of what mattered to you online, on your own storage. If the original is deleted or its site disappears, your copy stays.
about.step1: Paste it above the library, or use your phone's Share menu or the browser extension.
about.step2: Archiver currently reads each link as a logged-out visitor, without your accounts or your browser's cookies, so it archives what is public.
about.step3: The original media in its best quality, with the text, author and dates, on your disk or S3 bucket.
about.step4: Tags, notes, search and filters, and the full-screen Player.
about.keep1: Each archive holds an archive.json record with the fingerprint of every file. An altered or missing file shows up in To check.
about.keep2: Originals are checked regularly; those deleted from their site are listed in Gone.
about.keep3: Export the library gives a ZIP with every file and a page to browse them offline.
about.use: For personal use: keep what you have seen for yourself, respect copyright and each platform's terms, and do not redistribute archived content.
about.support: Archiver is a free open-source project maintained by one person. If you like it, please consider making a donation.
about.license: Free software under the AGPL-3.0 license.
